more like a cursed party trick
i meet someone right before the flower part

packed their bags in my hallway
shoes still warm laughs still hanging

the small green thing deciding against spring

my careful jokes my no pressure honestly
and still the room starts looking for an exit
sometimes it just learns your name
maybe i lean toward the light
when it was only a night
i'm always the almost then nearly the rain
the second best weather outside someone's main

there is a special kind of loneliness
and being trusted but not chosen
like being handed the spare key to a house
you're not invited to live in
i know where the cups are

but when the real storm comes
when the phone lights up at 2 13
and someone needs a voice it's not mine
i'm the backup generator with feelings
the person they call when their person is unavailable
ain't god that sentence has a basement
i've been the porch light for people who went home elsewhere
they understudy hard learning everyone's lines
just in case the lead gets sick
when i wanted to be loved
maybe i stood near the doorway
the second best weather outside someone's mane
i'm never the first call when the roof starts to bend
i tried to debug it once made a list
column a things i did wrong
column b things i probably did wrong
and whatever curse makes people say
with the energy of a closing tab
i keep trying to find the line where closeness fails to converge
the hidden axiom the bad variable
the crooked little if then the turn stay in to take care
maybe my end to two open
maybe i end to two guarded
maybe i make people feel seen
and then panic when they look back
maybe i'm easy to confess to
and difficult to need that one hurt
put a little reverb on that
one side to be the obvious choice
so i keep a garden of almost
and produced the very thought and belief
there was the one who laughed
like the window opened then closed
there was the one who said it was home
there was the one who made me feel centered
i was bored of thinking again
who trust me with the darkness
but there is a quiet arithmetic
in every room and i can count
i know the sound of my name
but i'll keep a light on that bright
just enough for the tools that might open
if i'm the almost the nearly friend
the one that could touch hold
with the old ones who then closed doors
